assume.text: Made-up projects, items, models and plan. Colour is never the only signal: every tile carries its type label. Stale tiles are dashed and muted. Model names, plan names and token numbers are placeholders.

dark.text: Dark theme on desktop: same layout as the light pages, with the phone artboards' dark values. Ground #F5F6F8 → #0E1014; card #FFFFFF → #171A21; border #E3E6EB → #262B35; text #14171C → #E8EAEE; muted #5B6370 → #9AA3B2; track #E9ECF0 → #262B35. Type tints and text: the dark pairs in Phone.dc.html. Model colours: #2a78d6 → #3987e5, #eb6834 → #d95926, #1baf7a → #199e70.

v2note.text: Made-up projects: example-app (busy), notes-site (quiet, folded by default), tools (only a question). A project with a question opens on load; after that it folds like any other. Stale session: example-app, Done, opened (dark desktop and light phone). Every card opens the drawer; the dark desktop shows it open on the working card.
